decisions.why: OR integration and hospital-efficiency platform, not a bracket/ perfusion/ endoscopy product like the rest of Getinge's range. Confirmed 13/09/2026 on getinge.com/int/products/tegris: 'one platform, for each operating room', combining video/data/device integration, HL7/DICOM connectivity and OR workflow software. Getinge's Digital Diagnostic Solutions award and the digital:sw category ('clinical and departmental software systems') are the right fit; the product is not counted anywhere else.

Vendor-neutral medical-device-to-EMR data-capture platform. Confirmed 13/09/2026 on getinge.com/int/products/talis-hub/: 'an integrated platform combining hardware, software, and support services' that 'captures data from any connected medical device and sends it directly to your EMR'. A clinical/departmental data-integration software product, fitting digital:sw; not counted anywhere else.
